scripts.dev: node scripts/opennext-config.mjs && node scripts/derive-facts.mjs && node scripts/derive-changelog.mjs && node scripts/derive-install.mjs && next dev
scripts.prebuild: node scripts/derive-facts.mjs && node scripts/derive-changelog.mjs && node scripts/derive-install.mjs
scripts.check: npm run check:facts && npm run check:latest-release && npm run prebuild && npm run check:docs && npm run check:tokens && npm run lint && tsc --noEmit && npm run build
scripts.check:docs: node scripts/derive-install.mjs && node scripts/check-docs.mjs && node scripts/render-terminal-capture.mjs --check
scripts.build:cloudflare: npm run build:opennext && node node_modules/wrangler/bin/cf-wrangler.js build
scripts.preview: npm run build:cloudflare && opennextjs-cloudflare populateCache local --config .cloudflare/opennext.json && node node_modules/wrangler/bin/cf-wrangler.js dev
scripts.deploy: npm run build:cloudflare && opennextjs-cloudflare populateCache remote --config .cloudflare/opennext.json && cf deploy --prebuilt
